title: Regional And National Planning
definition: National planning encompasses macroeconomic goal-setting and resource allocation at the central government level, whereas regional planning addresses spatial imbalances, localized socio-economic disparities, and sub-national resource optimization.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for GS Paper III (Indian Economy, Inclusive Growth, Regional Disparities) and GS Paper I (Geography - Regional Planning, Urbanization, Location of Industries). Frequently tested in Prelims via institutional mechanisms, statutory bodies, and decentralization provisions.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Regional And National Planning.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Understanding of India's Five-Year Plan history
Basics of federal fiscal architecture (Finance Commission, NITI Aayog)
